limitations.note: The rewrite fixes the default waveform but changes behavior under parameter overrides: for example, an 18-cycle even period is now high for nine ticks rather than the six produced by the minimal fix.

The default waveform check could catch the original bug, but this override check assumes the rewrite's new odd-only behavior for c89=0 instead of checking that the original mode-selection behavior was preserved.
